primary_genre.note: Adult describes the leads and emotional treatment, not an automatically explicit rating.

secondary_genres.confidence: high for first two; interpretive for third

intended_audience.value: Older-teen and adult readers drawn to restrained queer intimacy, material clues, and time-slip suspense.
intended_audience.age_focus: adult protagonists, 36 and 28 in their respective eras
intended_audience.gender_demographic: No reader gender assumed; BL does not establish who must read it.

content_rating.value: Provisional 16+ editorial guidance for suspense, death/fire themes, and danger; no explicit sexual content or graphic violence in the available chapter.
content_rating.decision_needed: Confirm intended intimacy, violence, ending tone, and publication venue before adopting a rating.

story_format.observed: One chapter-based close-third prose opening with an archive prelude and a continuous station encounter; fourteen legacy adaptation page scripts.
story_format.recommended: Chapter-based romantic mystery; preserve the existing chapter and title, use scene state changes to determine pacing.
story_format.future_arcs: Seven outlined arcs; 105 chapters is an aspiration in the notes, not a validated commitment.

reading_direction.reason: English output and no explicit source direction. Confirm before an approved storyboard or layout is produced.

manga_format.value: Paged monochrome manga with English lettering; color covers treated separately.
manga_format.page_count: Fourteen pages is the current Chapter 1 script count, not a locked target.

creative_goals: Make intimacy grow through specific shared work, humor, and objects.
Make historical investigation change both the rescue problem and the relationship.
Let Tomas choose and investigate, not merely be rescued.
Preserve an evidence-focused viewpoint while keeping the cafe uncanny.
Connect institutional erasure and personal preservation without turning theme into lectures.

reader_promise.proposed: Two adult men build something real in seven-minute meetings; every material clue and attempt to protect each other makes their impossible connection more consequential.
reader_promise.ending: Hopeful, bittersweet, or tragic resolution remains an author decision; do not advertise an unchosen ending.
reader_promise.status: evidence-based interpretation, not adopted creative brief

proposed: A reader can identify what each lead knows, wants, and risks at every turn.
Each recurring clue or meeting changes knowledge, agency, danger, or intimacy.
Time rules constrain the resolution without an unprepared exception.
The ending pays off the central relationship and fire investigation.
The creator can complete and review a sustainable release unit while retaining voice and source traceability.
definition_of_success.commercial_success: No claim or forecast; audience response must be tested.
definition_of_success.metrics: Phase 3 will select one to three measures after audit approval; none is presented as validated now.

scope_pacing_release.first_focus: Resolve audit decisions, then develop and evaluate the opening three-chapter sequence, beginning with the one supplied chapter; locate Chapter 2 or explicitly choose future drafting.
scope_pacing_release.arc_model: Keep the existing 15-chapter Arc 1 as a provisional envelope; permit chapter length and scene count to follow events after plan approval.
scope_pacing_release.long_series: Defer commitment to arcs 2-7 and 105 chapters until distinct arc payoffs and production capacity are demonstrated.
scope_pacing_release.release_structure: Chapter episodes grouped into seasons; no fixed weekly or monthly promise yet.
scope_pacing_release.buffer: Recommend a small completed-unit buffer before release; exact size and cadence require creator capacity and external art turnaround evidence.
scope_pacing_release.pacing: Retain quiet relational beats between investigative escalations; each meeting must change a meaningful state. Avoid mandatory cliffhangers or equal arc lengths.
scope_pacing_release.status: proposed; no publishing, scheduling, or community action authorized

open_decisions: Accept this as an audit of all available sources, while explicitly excluding unavailable Chapter 2/images, or supply recovered source material for an extended audit.
Approve diagnostic findings as a basis for Phase 3 planning, with corrections recorded.
During Phase 3, decide identity reconciliation, cafe/calendar/rule model, independent character goals, scope, setting, and ending boundaries.
Approve a preferred reconstruction option and dependency-ordered revision plan before any manuscript reconstruction.
Approve any canon adoption or stage lock separately and explicitly.
assumptions: No platform, budget, schedule, formal rights documentation, reader research, or historical-research pack was supplied.
